_about: Phrasings a published correction withdrew. tools/style.mjs fails a page that prints one again, outside a dated correction note (a block whose text carries 'Correction, <date>' or 'Corrected <date>' before the match) or a mention in curly double quotes. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against the rendered text. When you publish a correction, add its withdrawn wording here; 'correction' names the CORRECTIONS.md entry.
